verdict.text: The change does what the plan says.
All three okf-bundle rule copies now say `status` is `draft`, `stable` or `deprecated`, tell a draft apart from a proposal, and say how a draft becomes `stable` (status edit plus a `log.md` line).
ADR 0031 records the choice and rejects refusing `draft` in the schema.
The pinned hash and its comment moved to ADR 0031.
Gates are green.
Read the full working-tree diff against HEAD outside `.loop/` (the change is uncommitted in the worktree) and the new ADR 0031 in full.
Ran `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests and integration pass; eval rows r1 and r2 pass; "stamp green: fdc42394d86b926972a805b9edf4f6824442fb62fbefa4cbc858283390e25131".
Ran `uv run kmctl check` in the worktree: "all checks passed", exit 0.
r1: `test_okf_bundle_rule_allows_draft_status` reads all three copies, collapses whitespace, and asserts the old two-value phrase is absent and the three-value phrase is present.
It fails when any copy keeps the old wording or lacks `draft`, which is the row's `fails_when`.
r2: `test_package_rules_apply_to_the_old_globs_with_the_old_bodies` compares each body's sha256 to `OLD_RULES`; the okf-bundle hash is updated and the comment names ADR 0031.
43 package tests pass.

r3 (judgment): ADR 0031's Decision section says a record may be `draft` while it waits for acceptance, that `status` then becomes `stable` with a `log.md` line, that this is the one edit besides Correction sections and `kmctl decision supersede`, and how a draft differs from a proposal.
The Rejected paragraph names the other route from issue #27 (refuse `draft` in the schema and send choices to `proposals/`) and gives reasons.
The rule text says the same: the draft/proposal difference and the move to `stable` with a `log.md` line, and "Beyond that, a record is never rewritten" keeps the never-rewrite rule intact.
The Antigravity copy matches the Claude source byte for byte in the changed hunk, so the sync hook output agrees.
Row met.
Consistency: grep finds no other "stable or deprecated" wording outside `.loop/`, the test, and ADR 0031's Context (which quotes the old wording on purpose).
`docs/` and the manifesto have no conflicting text.
The decisions index and `log.md` gained ADR 0031 lines, and the summary's `checked` points at ADR 0031.
None.
The `OLD_RULES` comment no longer mentions ADR 0027 and its correction.
That is fine, because the comment names the ADR behind the body's current hash, and that is now ADR 0031.
